title: Augustana University Welcomes Record-Breaking Student Body for Academic Year 2026-27
summary_en: Augustana University welcomed a total of 2,652 students — part- and full-time undergraduate and graduate students — for Academic Year 2026-27. Hailing from 46 states and 48 countries, the number marks the largest ever student body in Augustana’s 166-year history.
title_cn: Augustana University Welcomes Record-Breaking Student Body for Academic Year 2026-27
